name: What kind of tiny homes require a permit in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: What kind of tiny homes require a permit in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text: In San Diego County, permits are typically required for tiny homes considered permanent structures or Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs). This includes tiny homes on foundations or those connected to utilities as a permanent residence. Tiny homes on wheels, if used as a primary dwelling and not just recreational vehicles, may also require ADU permits depending on specific local ordinances. It's important to differentiate between an RV and a tiny home built to residential code when seeking permits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes considered permanent structures or Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) in San Diego County generally require permits. This includes most tiny homes on foundations or used as primary dwellings.
